scope: read-only primary-source research; no model, package, or audio inference was downloaded or run

verified: Repository includes pretrained .pt weights and describes BeatNet as CRNN plus particle filtering with online and offline modes.
Training configuration says 400 frames are 8 seconds at 50 fps.
Source is BSD; model/data files are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
RNNBeatProcessor frontend is mono 44.1 kHz, 2048-sample frames, STFT, 12-band 30–17000 Hz filtered log spectrogram; activation is 100 fps.
RNN beat models are separate pretrained assets, not an ARM export artifact.
Official pretrained model/data repository licenses model files CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which blocks a general commercial standalone delivery.

architecture.beatnet: CRNN activation network plus causal particle filter for online inference; exact layer/operator inventory and weight byte size are unverified until a pinned tree and model file are inspected.
architecture.madmom: RNN/TCN activation ensembles plus DBN/HMM decoding; source documents an online LSTM option, but model assets are non-commercial.

tempo_range.verified: Neither inspected primary README states a supported 40–240 BPM guarantee.
tempo_range.decision: Both require explicit 40/60/120/180/240 and half/double validation; do not infer coverage from a tracker default.

armv7_assessment.candidate: BeatNet online CRNN activation model exported from a pinned PyTorch state dict to ONNX, then executed with a separately validated ARMv7 runtime; keep particle filtering as native deterministic code.
conversion_requirements: Pin source commit, weight SHA-256, CC-BY attribution, PyTorch version, input sample rate and feature normalization.
Export only the CRNN with fixed or bounded 50-fps feature shapes; inventory Conv/RNN/normalization operators and prove ONNX-vs-PyTorch activation parity.
Benchmark 45-second 16 kHz capture after the required resampling/frontend, RAM, warm/cold latency, 40–240 BPM and octave/uncertainty controls on ARMv7.
known_limitations: No inspected source establishes ARMv7 support, ONNX export success, weight size, or 40–240 BPM accuracy.
BeatNet weights are CC BY 4.0 at repository level but per-file provenance/hash still needs pinning.
madmom pretrained weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and are research comparison only unless a separate licence is obtained.

decision: Investigate BeatNet online as the one actionable pretrained comparison, but do not select it for standalone release until artifact/operator/ARM evidence is produced. Exclude madmom pretrained RNN weights from a broadly redistributable standalone candidate due CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
